leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a function to accept a string input for palindrome validation
Apply string normalization to remove non-alphanumeric characters and standardize case
Construct a loop to compare characters from both ends of the string
Manipulate indices to traverse the string efficiently
Implement a return statement that outputs a boolean result
Integrate the validation function into a simple test case
Control the flow to handle edge cases like empty strings or single characters
